name: SuperStickyNote
desc: Floating sticky quick-notes for Supernote. Tap the launcher bubble and a draggable post-it appears over your notebook or document; type on it with the keyboard, or write on it with the pen. Lasso handwriting to keep it in a sticky note as you wrote it, recognised as text, or both; or select PDF text. Every capture links back to its page, and goes back on the page as ink or as an editable text box. Notes and .txt exports live in MyStyle/Plugins/SuperStickyNote.
